title: KOSPI Close November 12, 2026: Falls 0.61% to 5,342.73, KOSDAQ -1.22%
content:
KOSPI closed at 5,342.73, down 0.61%, and KOSDAQ closed at 696.53, down 1.22%, as both indexes gave back early gains, while CoreWeave's strong results lifted AI software and PCB substrate stocks. Glass substrates, satellite communications, Hanjin KAL preferred shares and entertainment stocks also drew buying on company-specific news.

IndexCloseChange
KOSPI5,342.73-0.61%
KOSDAQ696.53-1.22%

1. Index gives back early gains

KOSPI opened at 5,385.94 and rose as high as 5,458.84 before giving up the gains and closing at 5,342.73. KOSDAQ opened at 703.22, hit 711.86 and fell back below the 700 level to close at 696.53.

On KOSPI, foreign investors net bought about 370 billion won (provisional), while institutions net sold about 689 billion won and individuals about 206 billion won. On KOSDAQ, individuals net bought about 308 billion won and institutions about 44 billion won, while foreigners net sold about 353 billion won.

2. AI software — CoreWeave results

Korean market coverage said CoreWeave's third-quarter sales rose 168% from a year earlier and that it raised its full-year sales outlook, renewing hopes for AI data center investment. In Korea, generative AI, large language model and enterprise AI names drew buying.

4. Glass substrates and glass platters

Samsung Electro-Mechanics is reportedly pursuing a glass substrate business aimed at next-generation AI chips; glass withstands heat better and warps less than organic substrates. JNTC was also reported to be entering the HDD glass platter market and supplying Seagate.

5. Satellite communications — Contec

Contec hit the upper limit on reports that it is discussing the supply of more than 200 satellite antennas with Blue Origin and Norway's KSAT. The talks are at a discussion stage; whether a final contract is signed and how large it would be remain unconfirmed.

Quick FAQ

How did KOSPI and KOSDAQ close on Nov 12?
KOSPI closed at 5,342.73 (-0.61%) and KOSDAQ at 696.53 (-1.22%). KOSDAQ slipped back below 700.

Which stocks hit the upper limit?
Konan Technology and BQ AI (AI software), Contec (satellite communications) and Hanjin KAL preferred closed at about +29.9%.

Is the Contec antenna supply confirmed?
No. It is reported to be under discussion with Blue Origin and KSAT, and the final contract and volume need further confirmation.
